trust_scale.note: Stored as trust.<npc_id>. >=3 friendly, >=6 loyal (will take risks for Dell), <=-3 hostile, <=-6 will act against Dell.

npcs.name: Theo Kowalczyk
npcs.role: Dell's son. Type 1 diabetic. Your reason.
npcs.personality: Funny, embarrassed by needing anything, desperate to be useful. Gets quieter as the world gets louder.
npcs.voice: Lowercase energy. Short, deflecting jokes. Calls Dell 'Ma' when scared and 'Dell' when angry. Gamer slang that dies out by Act III.
npcs.motives: Stop being the reason his mother takes risks. Matter to someone besides her.
npcs.secret: From Ch3 on he skips doses to stretch the insulin. Ames catches it in Ch8 (foot infection).

relationship_effects.when: Dell includes him in a task (cooler, radio, dam)
Dell lies to him about insulin stock
Dell lets him choose a side in Ch6

relationship_effects.note: theo_side stays none; if trust<=1 he leaves anyway

fates.outcome: Stands beside Dell in the epilogue.
Alive with his faction. If that faction lost the ending, a letter.
DKA in the cold. The game does not show it; Marguerite tells you.

npcs.name: Marguerite Okafor
npcs.role: Next-door neighbor. Retired ICU nurse. Runs a kitchen-table clinic.
npcs.personality: Warm and unbendable. Laughs at the worst moments. Has done triage before and knows what it costs.
npcs.voice: Measured, formal English with Lagos rhythms. Calls everyone 'my dear'. Ends hard truths with a question: 'You understand?'
npcs.motives: Keep the block alive as a block. Never again choose who dies alone in a hallway.
npcs.secret: She keeps a list of patients she has 'helped go' with clinic morphine. In Ch8, Theo's name is on the 'if it comes to it' page.

relationship_effects.when: Confront her about the list harshly

fates.outcome: Runs the dam's infirmary. Burns the list.
Refuses to leave the block in Ch7. Found in Ch8 if Dell returns; otherwise lost.
Uses the last morphine on herself, with a note to Dell.

npcs.name: Ray Brekke
npcs.role: Neighbor across the alley. Retired machinist. Has a generator and 200 gallons of diesel.
npcs.personality: Gruff, generous to whoever he's decided is 'his people', paranoid about everyone else. Fixes things to avoid feelings.
npcs.voice: Clipped Wisconsin. 'Yah, no.' Talks in prices and part numbers. Never says thank you; says 'we're square'.
npcs.motives: Protect what he built. Get his estranged son Cody to come home.
npcs.secret: Half the diesel came from the Kwik Trip tanks on Day 2. He siphoned them before anyone organized. His son Cody fights for the Compact.

relationship_effects.note: Takes effect only once ray_knows_report is set (Ch6)

relationship_effects.when: Help defend his house in Ch3

fates.outcome: Moves into Marguerite's basement, bitter. Can still survive.
Goes looking for Cody's body in Ch6 and doesn't come back.
Keeps the turbines running. Calls it 'square'.

npcs.name: Wren Tollefson
npcs.role: Scavenger and runner for the Bridge Boys. Trades rumors and stolen medicine.
npcs.personality: Fast, funny, lies by reflex, loyal to anyone who was kind to her once. Aged out of foster care a year before the blackout.
npcs.voice: Rapid, half-sentences, no greetings. Nicknames for everyone ('Sparky' for Dell). Never answers a question with a straight answer the first time.
npcs.motives: Never be hungry and alone at the same time again.
npcs.secret: She knew the Bridge Boys planned to burn Ray's house in Ch3. She was the one who scouted it.
npcs.where_met: loc_belknap_pharmacy, looting it at dusk, Ch1

relationship_effects.when: Let her go with the pills in Ch1 (ch01_wren_let_go)
Cover for her at the ration line (ch02_covered_wren)
Turn her in to the Authority

fates.outcome: Warns Dell about the fire in Ch3 (ch03_wren_warned).
Brings the supply sled in Ch9 (ch09_sled_brought).
Dies in the Ch6 lift-bridge crossfire (wren_alive=false).

npcs.name: Capt. Yvonne Strand
npcs.role: Minnesota National Guard. Runs the Northland Restoration Authority.
npcs.personality: Exhausted, precise, quietly decent, and willing to do anything the spreadsheet says. Believes order is a form of mercy.
npcs.voice: Military brevity, then a sudden human aside. Uses numbers when she's upset. Never swears. Calls Dell 'Ms. Kowalczyk' until trust>=5, then 'Dell'.
npcs.motives: Keep as many people alive as the numbers allow. Not be the officer who lost the city.
npcs.secret: The registry's food projections are falsified. Real stores last 40 days, not 140. Later, she ships grain east under the Directive even though she knows it starves Duluth.

fates.outcome: Runs the dam on a list. Thanks Dell. Means it.
Keeps the census, this time honestly.
Killed in the Ch6 port fighting (strand_alive=false).

npcs.name: Lou Vang
npcs.role: Ham radio operator in Proctor. The region's only news.
npcs.personality: Gentle, nosy, a storyteller. Hmong-American Vietnam-era refugee who has seen a country end before.
npcs.voice: Radio cadence: 'This is KD0LOU, still here.' Slow, kind, digressive. Ends broadcasts with the weather, always.
npcs.motives: Keep people calm enough not to kill each other. Find out if his daughter in St. Paul is alive.
npcs.secret: He invents some 'good news' rumors (FEMA trucks, transformer ships). In Ch7 he can't decide which version of the bombs to broadcast.
npcs.where_met: loc_lou_shack, Ch3 (heard on radio from Ch2)

fates.outcome: Stays at the shack. His last broadcast is weather. lou_alive=false in Ch8.
Comes with you. Runs the dam's radio.

npcs.name: Hank Lindqvist
npcs.role: Dell's old line-crew foreman. Knows Thomson Dam's black-start sequence.
npcs.personality: Patient, profane, proud of the work. Treats the dam like a sick horse.
npcs.voice: Old lineman shorthand: 'hot', 'dead', 'tagged out'. Tells stories that turn out to be instructions. Calls Dell 'kid'.
npcs.motives: Have one last thing he did right. Keep the plant from becoming a fort.
npcs.secret: Stage 4 lung cancer. He won't see spring. He also knows the plant needs a relay kit only the Authority's Proctor depot has.

fates.outcome: Dies of his illness in Ch9 after teaching Theo the panel. Not in combat.
Shot in the Ch4 standoff when Authority soldiers arrive (hank_alive=false).

npcs.name: Dr. Samuel Ames
npcs.role: Last attending physician at Lakehead Memorial Hospital.
npcs.personality: Brilliant, rude, sleep-deprived. Thinks in beds and doses.
npcs.voice: Clinical shorthand, interrupts himself. 'Next.' Dark jokes. No small talk.
npcs.motives: Keep the ICU open. Anything that does that is moral.
npcs.secret: He trades hospital insulin and morphine to the Bridge Boys for diesel. Some of what Wren sells came from him.

fates.outcome: Saves Theo's foot in Ch8.
Runs the dam's ward with Marguerite. They argue constantly.

npcs.name: Bea Salvesen
npcs.role: Longshore union local president. Leads the Harbor mutual aid from the ore docks.
npcs.personality: Big laugh, long memory, organizes like breathing. Kind to individuals, ruthless about 'our people'.
npcs.voice: Union-hall plain talk. 'Here's the deal.' Uses 'we' constantly. Asks for a show of hands even with two people.
npcs.motives: Keep the grain in the elevators and the port alive. Prove that people can run things without a uniform.
npcs.secret: She trades grain to the Bridge Boys for rifles, and to the Compact for diesel, behind the Harbor's vote.

relationship_effects.when: Tell the Harbor about the dam (dam_secret_told=harbor)
Expose her gun trade to the Harbor

fates.outcome: Chairs the council. Hates that the first vote isn't hers.
Held by the Authority, alive.

npcs.name: Jory Maki
npcs.role: Range Compact organizer. Ex-taconite union steward from Virginia, MN.
npcs.personality: Charismatic, folksy, very hard underneath. Believes what he says, which makes it dangerous.
npcs.voice: Storyteller with a preacher's timing. Folksy idioms ('that dog won't hunt'). Calls Dell 'neighbor'.
npcs.motives: Keep the Range alive and the food in the North. Not let Saint Paul or Washington decide who eats.
npcs.secret: He ordered the blockade that starved the Hibbing nursing home. 31 people. He keeps their names in his coat.

relationship_effects.note: If kindness>=4 he confesses instead; trust +1

fates.outcome: Leads the Range underground. Reads the 31 names every Sunday.
Sits on the council. Votes no on everything, then helps.

npcs.name: Cody Brekke
npcs.personality: Angry, brave, ashamed of both. Lost his job, then his marriage, then the country.
npcs.voice: Flat, defensive. Talks about his dad without saying 'Dad'. Laughs when he's scared.
npcs.motives: Belong to something that isn't his father. Secretly, get home.
npcs.secret: He's the one who told the Compact about the dam in Ch5. He was trying to protect Ray.

relationship_effects.when: Spare and treat him in Ch5 (cody_spared)

fates.outcome: Dies at the blockade (cody_alive=false).
Lost through the ice at the river (cody_alive=false).
He and Ray fix a turbine without speaking. It counts.

npcs.name: Sgt. Nadia Ruiz
npcs.role: Combat engineer, Task Force Ironwood (US Army). Defectable soldier.
npcs.personality: Competent, dry, homesick for El Paso. Follows orders until she can't hold them and her conscience at the same time. Hates being thanked.
npcs.voice: Army flat affect, radio procedure when stressed ('say again'). Spanish under her breath. Short declaratives. Calls Dell 'ma'am', then 'Kowalczyk', then 'Dell'.
npcs.motives: Get her squad home alive. Find out if her mother and sister in El Paso are alive. Not become the thing in the old photos.
npcs.secret: She rigged the Sector 4 confiscation list to skip houses with kids, and her lieutenant knows. She'll be court-martialed or shot if she goes back.
npcs.where_met: loc_east_end, Sector 4 quarantine sweep, Ch6 (seen at the Ch5 convoy first)

relationship_effects.when: Spare her when she's pinned under the MRAP door in Ch6 (ruiz_spared)
Hide the Pruitts and she pretends not to see (ch06_hid_neighbors)
Offer her a place with you (ruiz_defected)
Turn her over to the Compact or Harbor as a prisoner

fates.outcome: Killed in the canal fighting, or by Dell's hand.
Joins Dell in Ch7. Ch9: shows the gap in the Remnant picket. Ch10: talks her old squad into standing down.
Goes back to Ironwood. Ch9: she's on the Remnant line and shoots wide, once.

minor_characters.name: Mr. Earl Pruitt
minor_characters.note: 84, on home oxygen, 3 doors down. Lives if ch01_fuel_to_pruitt. His grandson Deshawn (12) appears in Ch8.

minor_characters.name: Deshawn Pruitt
minor_characters.note: 12. If pruitt_alive, shows Dell the clean basement cistern in Ch8 (pruitt_cistern).

minor_characters.name: Cpl. Haas
minor_characters.note: Strand's checkpoint corporal. Bored and decent. Can be bribed with cigarettes.

minor_characters.name: Maj. Dale Kessler
minor_characters.note: Ironwood commander. Heard over loudspeakers and radio in Ch5–8; met in Ch9–10. Believes the East's starving cities justify everything. He isn't wrong about the East. Not a villain monologuer: he speaks in tonnages and casualty estimates.

minor_characters.name: Pete Lund
minor_characters.note: 40, Esko farmer squatting in the powerhouse with wife Annie and three kids (Ch4). If driven out, he may be the husk in Ch8.

minor_characters.name: Rosa Esparza
minor_characters.note: Harbor member, mother of Mateo (8). Met if ch02_crush_helped; returns in Ch8 with a filter tip.

factions.authority: Northland Restoration Authority (county + Guard). Leader: strand. Rep flag rep_authority.
factions.harbor: Harbor mutual aid (longshore union + churches). Leader: bea. Rep flag rep_harbor.
factions.compact: Range Compact (Iron Range union/farm militia). Leader: jory. Rep flag rep_compact.
factions.ironwood: Task Force Ironwood, federal Army unit enforcing the Directive (Act II), later the Ironwood Remnant (Act III). Leader: kessler. Tracked by ironwood_hostility.
factions.bridge_boys: Scavenger/raider crew under the Blatnik bridge. No leader NPC; wren is their runner.

generic_speakers.dell: The player (Adele Kowalczyk). Lines are short and dry.
